abaplint-delete-index-in-loop.describe: DELETE <t> INDEX sy-tabix inside an open LOOP AT <t>, and the correct READ-TABLE-then-DELETE form as the negative

abaplint-subrc-after-assign.describe: a sy-subrc test whose nearest sy-subrc-setting statement is a plain ASSIGN, with ASSIGN COMPONENT as the negative

abaplint-abap-final-newline.describe: a file not ending with exactly one newline, with the correctly terminated files counted per repository

abaplint-abapdoc-html-tag.describe: an unsupported tag-like token in ABAP Doc, with the ABAP Doc markup tags as the negatives

abaplint-default-key-implicit.describe: an implicit default-key table declaration, with the explicit WITH DEFAULT KEY as the negative

abaplint-deref-of-method-call.describe: `)->*` — a call or constructor expression dereferenced inline, with `var->*` as the negative

abaplint-empty-catch-block.describe: an empty CATCH block without ##NO_HANDLER, with the pragma-carrying one as the negative

abaplint-get-reference-obsolete.describe: GET REFERENCE OF, with the REF constructor as the negative

abaplint-into-corresponding-inline-decl.describe: CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF … @DATA( ) in a SELECT, with INTO TABLE @DATA( ) and a declared target as the negatives

abaplint-ref-into-generic-target.describe: REF #( ) assigned to a generically typed target, with the typed target as the negative

abaplint-type-handle-method-call.describe: a CREATE DATA/OBJECT … TYPE HANDLE operand that is a call, with the plain variable operand as the negative
